name: note-audio
description: Sidebar audio player for notes narrated by the Kokoro render pipeline.

quartz.name: note-audio
quartz.description: Sidebar play/pause card for notes that have been narrated by the local Kokoro render pipeline (scripts/audio_pipeline/render.py).

NoteAudio.description: Play/pause card, progress bar, and download link for a note's narrated audio. Renders nothing unless the note's frontmatter audio_hash matches a build-time hash of the cleaned note text.
